knowledge_abstraction.bug_theme: Unchecked view metadata can make logical extents exceed the underlying storage
knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: View or alias operations may trust caller-provided size and stride metadata without validating that the resulting logical range is contained within the actual storage. Subsequent materializing operations then iterate according to invalid metadata and access out-of-bounds memory.

risk_dimensions.shape: Oversized or non-contiguous view shapes whose logical extents exceed the allocated input storage
risk_dimensions.dtype: Different dtypes change element sizes and stride byte calculations, which can shift reachable memory boundaries
risk_dimensions.memory: Custom size and stride metadata maps logical elements outside the allocated tensor storage
risk_dimensions.device: CPU backend memory access behavior and sanitizer coverage
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Metadata-only view or alias creation followed by a materializing iteration or reduction operation

failure_mechanism.description: View or alias creation does not validate that user-controlled sizes and strides keep the accessible logical range within storage bounds. A later materializing kernel iterates according to the invalid view metadata and performs out-of-bounds reads.

input_exploration: Vary view sizes and stride values, especially oversized or non-contiguous strides
Explore small input storages combined with requested logical extents that exceed storage bounds
Test metadata-only view or alias operations followed by materializing operations
constraint_awareness: Storage offset plus stride times size minus one must stay within storage bounds
View and alias metadata may be untrusted and must be validated against actual storage
Materializing operations assume valid view metadata and may expose invalid accesses
oracle_strategy: Use AddressSanitizer or another memory sanitizer to detect heap-buffer-overflow
Monitor for out-of-bounds reads or crashes when the view is accessed
Compare against a reference implementation that derives view shapes from valid storage bounds

transferability.reason: The principle that view and alias APIs must validate size and stride metadata against actual storage applies broadly to reshape, expand, permute, slice, as_strided, and other metadata-changing operations in deep learning frameworks.

important_considerations: Probe view and alias operations with inconsistent size, stride, or storage_offset metadata
Follow metadata-only operations with materializing kernels to trigger latent invalid accesses
Consider element-size interactions for different dtypes when computing stride byte ranges
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that construct valid small tensors, then apply view or alias operations with mutated or user-controlled metadata and execute a downstream materializing operation. Rely on sanitizers to detect invalid accesses rather than copying the original issue parameters.
